content: Audio playback in Tauri: HTML5 audio has issues on Safari (random restarts, no streaming, no .ogg support), sounds work in dev but not in production builds with remote URLs, autoplay may not work on Windows without user interaction. Better to use Rust-side audio via rodio/cpal for reliable streaming. rodio requires f32 hardware support and ALSA dev files on Linux. The afplay Rust crate was built specifically for Tauri audio playback use cases.
